sources.snippet: Q: What is the difference between this model and the 4-bit quantized version? A: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-bnb-4bit applies 4-bit quantization after training, reducing memory usage further for finetuning and inference while slightly reducing output quality.

sources.title: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-unsloth-bnb-4bit · Models
sources.snippet: See our collection for versions of Llama 3.1 including GGUF & 4-bit formats. Unsloth's Dynamic 4-bit Quants is selectively quantized, greatly improving accuracy over standard 4-bit.

sources.snippet: The Meta Llama 3.1 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction tuned generative models in 8B, 70B and 405B sizes (text in/text out).
